question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"factor."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Factor"** means a circumstance, fact, or influence that contributes to a result or outcome. (किसी निर्णय, स्थिति आदि को प्रभावित करने वाला तत्‍व; कारक) • **Example**: *His unhappiness at home was a major **factor**__ in his decision to go abroad.* • It is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank in the given sentence. • Grammatically, it fits in as a noun in the sentence structure. • Other options like **"exposure", "part", and "maker" **do not fit in the sentence contextually or grammatically. • The correct answer is Option 4.​ • Correct passage: An 'occupational disease' is any disease __caused__ primarily by exposure at work __to__ a physical, organisational, chemical or biological risk __factor__ or to a combination of these factors. Occupational diseases are ______ (4) ______ those listed in national legislation as resulting from exposure to risk factors at ______ (5) ______. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1,** "exposure",** means the state of being exposed to something, such as a disease or danger. (किसी वस्‍तु को प्रदर्शित करने की क्रिया; प्रदर्शित की गई वस्‍तु, रहस्‍योद्‌घाटन, प्रदर्शन) • Option 2,** "part",** means a piece or segment of something. (अंश, भाग, खंड, हिस्‍सा) • Option 3, **"maker",** refers to a person or company that makes or produces something. (किसी वस्‍तु का निर्माता व्यक्ति, कंपनी या मशीन) 1f1:Tc9b, The correct answer is **"mostly."**
